verdict.rationale: Steel publishes a first-party API reference with per-resource endpoint pages for Captchas, Credentials, Files and general building, backed by a live OpenAPI spec at docs.steel.dev/openapi.json. A community member also praised the 'beautiful docs + api ref'. However, the evidence never shows the reference is interactive or includes runnable examples, so only the reference itself is confirmed. Missing for 10: documented in-browser 'try it' or runnable request execution, code examples within the reference, hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
